# Pipeline Overview

The BMF processing pipeline is organized into **11 sequential phases**, each with a specific responsibility. The pipeline is orchestrated by `R/run_pipeline.R`.

## 11-Phase Pipeline

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 8
flowchart TB
    subgraph Phase1["Phase 1: Extraction"]
        A1[Download from S3] --> A2[Parse Year/Month]
        A2 --> A3[Save Raw Local Copy]
    end

    subgraph Phase2["Phase 2: Pre-Validation"]
        B1[Validate Column Structure] --> B2[Check Row Count]
        B2 --> B3[Detect Duplicates]
    end

    subgraph Phase3["Phase 3: Identity"]
        C1[EIN] --> C2[Organization Name]
        C2 --> C3[DBA Name]
        C3 --> C4[ICO Name]
        C4 --> C5[Group Exemption]
        C5 --> C6[Ruling Date]
        C6 --> C7[Address]
    end

    subgraph Phase4["Phase 4: Classification"]
        D1[Subsection/Classification] --> D2[Affiliation]
        D2 --> D3[Deductibility]
        D3 --> D4[Foundation]
        D4 --> D5[Organization]
        D5 --> D6[Status]
    end

    subgraph Phase5["Phase 5: Activity"]
        E1[Activity Codes] --> E2[NTEE Codes]
    end

    subgraph Phase6["Phase 6: Temporal"]
        F1[Tax Period] --> F2[Accounting Period]
    end

    subgraph Phase7["Phase 7: Financial"]
        G1[Asset Code] --> G2[Income Code]
        G2 --> G3[Asset Amount]
        G3 --> G4[Income Amount]
        G4 --> G5[Revenue Amount]
    end

    subgraph Phase8["Phase 8: Filing"]
        H1[Filing Requirement] --> H2[PF Filing Requirement]
    end

    subgraph Phase9["Phase 9: Post-Validation"]
        I1[Quality Metrics] --> I2[Generate Report]
    end

    subgraph Phase10["Phase 10: Intermediate Output"]
        J1[Save Intermediate BMF] --> J2[Upload to S3]
    end

    subgraph Phase11["Phase 11: Processed Output"]
        K1[Save Processed BMF] --> K2[Data Dictionary] --> K3[Upload to S3]
    end

    Phase1 --> Phase2
    Phase2 --> Phase3
    Phase3 --> Phase4
    Phase4 --> Phase5
    Phase5 --> Phase6
    Phase6 --> Phase7
    Phase7 --> Phase8
    Phase8 --> Phase9
    Phase9 --> Phase10
    Phase10 --> Phase11
```

## Phase Details

### Phase 1: Extraction

Downloads BMF data from S3 bucket `nccsdata`. A Lambda function ingests monthly BMF files from the IRS and deposits them at `nccsdata/raw/bmf/YYYY-MM-BMF.csv`.

The pipeline: 1. Connects to S3 using `aws.s3` package 2. Downloads the most recent BMF file (or a specified year/month) 3. Extracts processing year and month from filename 4. Saves local copy to `data/raw/bmf_YYYY_MM.csv`

``` r
# Download most recent BMF
bmf_raw <- download_bmf_from_s3()

# Download specific month
bmf_raw <- download_bmf_from_s3(year = 2025, month = 1)

# List available files
list_available_bmf_files()
# [1] "2025-01" "2024-12" "2024-11" ...
```

### Phase 2: Pre-Transformation Validation

Validates the raw data before any transformations:

-   **Column Check**: Ensures all 31 required columns exist
-   **Row Count**: Verifies \~1.9M rows (within 5% tolerance)
-   **Duplicate Detection**: Counts duplicate EINs
-   **NULL Inventory**: Reports NULL counts per column

If validation fails in strict mode, the pipeline stops.

### Phase 3: Identity Transformations

Transforms organization identification fields:

| Transform | Input | Outputs |
|-----------------------------|-------------------|------------------------|
| `transform_ein()` | EIN | `ein`, `ein_raw` |
| `transform_organization_name()` | NAME | `org_name_raw`, `org_name_join`, `org_name_display`, `org_legal_suffix` |
| `transform_dba_name()` | SORT_NAME | `dba_name`, `dba_name_raw` |
| `transform_ico_name()` | ICO | `in_care_of_name_raw`, `in_care_of_name_clean`, `in_care_of_name_provided` |
| `transform_group_exemption_number()` | GROUP | `group_exemption_number_raw`, `group_exemption_number`, `group_exemption_is_member` |
| `transform_ruling_date()` | RULING | `ruling_date_ym_str`, `ruling_date`, `ruling_date_is_missing` |
| `transform_address()` | STREET, CITY, STATE, ZIP | 17 columns (see [Transform Reference](03-transforms-reference.qmd)) |

### Phase 4: Classification Transformations

Adds IRS classification codes with human-readable definitions:

| Transform | Lookup Table | Outputs |
|-----------------------|-----------------------------|--------------------|
| `transform_subsection_classification_codes()` | `classification_subsection_code_lookup.csv` | `subsection_code`, `classification_code`, `exempt_organization_type`, `all_classifications_string` |
| `transform_affiliation_code()` | `affiliation_code_lookup.csv` | `affiliation_code`, `affiliation_code_definition` |
| `transform_deductibility_code()` | `deductibility_code_lookup.csv` | `deductibility_code`, `deductibility_code_definition` |
| `transform_foundation_code()` | `foundation_code_lookup.csv` | `foundation_code`, `foundation_code_definition` |
| `transform_organization_code()` | `organization_code_lookup.csv` | `organization_code`, `organization_code_definition` |
| `transform_status_code()` | `bmf_code_lookup.xlsx` | `status_code`, `status_code_definition` |

### Phase 5: Activity Transformations

Creates dimension tables for multi-valued activity fields. These are temporary tables used for internal joins, since each activity code references multiple activities.

| Transform | Pattern | Outputs |
|---------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------------|
| `create_activity_code_dim_table()` | SCD Type 2 | `dim_activity_2025.parquet` |
| `transform_activity_code()` | Aggregate | `activity_code_definitions`, `activity_code_categories` |
| `transform_ntee_code()` | Complex | `ntee_code`, `ntee_code_definition`, `ntee_code_major_group`, `naics_code`, `nteev2_code`, etc. |

### Phase 6: Temporal Transformations

Parses date and period fields:

| Transform | Input | Outputs |
|-----------------------------|-------------------|------------------------|
| `transform_tax_period()` | TAX_PERIOD | `tax_period_ymd`, `tax_period_is_missing` |
| `transform_accounting_period()` | ACCT_PD | `accounting_period_code`, `accounting_period_definition` |

### Phase 7: Financial Transformations

Processes financial codes and amounts:

| Transform | Input | Outputs |
|-----------------------------|-------------------|------------------------|
| `transform_asset_code()` | ASSET_CD | `asset_code`, `asset_code_definition` |
| `transform_income_code()` | INCOME_CD | `income_code`, `income_code_definition` |
| `transform_asset_amount()` | ASSET_AMT | `asset_amount` |
| `transform_income_amount()` | INCOME_AMT | `income_amount` |
| `transform_revenue_amount()` | REVENUE_AMT | `revenue_amount` |

### Phase 8: Filing Requirement Transformations

Adds filing requirement classifications:

| Transform | Input | Outputs |
|-----------------------------|-------------------|------------------------|
| `transform_code()` | FILING_REQ_CD | `filing_requirement_code`, `filing_requirement_code_definition` |
| `transform_code()` | PF_FILING_REQ_CD | `pf_filing_requirement_code`, `pf_filing_requirement_code_definition` |

### Phase 9: Post-Transformation Validation

Generates a comprehensive quality report:

-   Row preservation check (input rows = output rows)
-   Completeness rates for all columns
-   Critical field validation (EIN, subsection_code)
-   Summary statistics

### Phase 10: Intermediate Output

Saves the **complete** BMF with all columns (both raw IRS columns and transformed columns) to local storage and S3. This preserves the full data lineage for debugging and auditing.

**What Gets Saved:**

| File | Format | Contents |
|------|--------|----------|
| Intermediate BMF | Parquet | All ~90 columns (27 raw + ~63 transformed) |
| Quality Report | JSON | Validation metrics and summary statistics |

**Local Files:**

-   `data/intermediate/bmf_YYYY_MM_intermediate.parquet`
-   `data/quality/bmf_YYYY_MM_quality_report.json`

**S3 Upload (when `ENABLE_S3_UPLOAD = TRUE`):**

Uses `upload_bmf_results()` function to upload to the **intermediate** folder:

-   `s3://nccsdata/intermediate/bmf/YYYY_MM/bmf_YYYY_MM_intermediate.parquet`
-   `s3://nccsdata/intermediate/bmf/YYYY_MM/bmf_YYYY_MM_quality_report.json`

### Phase 11: Processed Output

Creates a **clean** version of the BMF by removing the original IRS columns, keeping only transformed columns. Also generates a data dictionary describing each column.

**Raw Columns Removed (27 total):**

```
EIN, NAME, ICO, STREET, CITY, STATE, ZIP, GROUP, SUBSECTION,
AFFILIATION, CLASSIFICATION, RULING, DEDUCTIBILITY, FOUNDATION,
ACTIVITY, ORGANIZATION, STATUS, TAX_PERIOD, ASSET_CD, INCOME_CD,
FILING_REQ_CD, PF_FILING_REQ_CD, ASSET_AMT, INCOME_AMT,
REVENUE_AMT, NTEE_CD, SORT_NAME, ACCT_PD, REGION
```

**What Gets Saved:**

| File | Format | Contents |
|------|--------|----------|
| Processed BMF | CSV | ~63 transformed columns only |
| Data Dictionary | CSV | Column names, types, descriptions, sample values |
| Quality Report | JSON | Same report as Phase 10 |
| Quality Report | HTML | Rendered visualization for GitHub Pages |

**Local Files:**

-   `data/processed/bmf_YYYY_MM_processed.csv`
-   `data/processed/bmf_YYYY_MM_data_dictionary.csv`
-   `docs/quality-reports/YYYY_MM.html`

**S3 Upload (when `ENABLE_S3_UPLOAD = TRUE`):**

Uses `upload_processed_bmf()` function to upload to the **processed** folder:

-   `s3://nccsdata/processed/bmf/YYYY_MM/bmf_YYYY_MM_processed.csv`
-   `s3://nccsdata/processed/bmf/YYYY_MM/bmf_YYYY_MM_data_dictionary.csv`
-   `s3://nccsdata/processed/bmf/YYYY_MM/bmf_YYYY_MM_quality_report.json`

### Output Comparison

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    subgraph Phase10["Phase 10: Intermediate"]
        I1[("Parquet<br/>~90 cols")]
        I2[("Quality<br/>JSON")]
    end

    subgraph Phase11["Phase 11: Processed"]
        P1[("CSV<br/>~63 cols")]
        P2[("Dictionary<br/>CSV")]
        P3[("Quality<br/>JSON + HTML")]
    end

    subgraph S3Int["S3: intermediate/bmf/"]
        S3I1["bmf_YYYY_MM_intermediate.parquet"]
        S3I2["bmf_YYYY_MM_quality_report.json"]
    end

    subgraph S3Proc["S3: processed/bmf/"]
        S3P1["bmf_YYYY_MM_processed.csv"]
        S3P2["bmf_YYYY_MM_data_dictionary.csv"]
        S3P3["bmf_YYYY_MM_quality_report.json"]
    end

    I1 --> S3I1
    I2 --> S3I2
    P1 --> S3P1
    P2 --> S3P2
    P3 --> S3P3
```

**When to Use Each Output:**

| Use Case | Recommended Output |
|----------|-------------------|
| Research and analysis | Processed CSV |
| Debugging transformations | Intermediate Parquet |
| Auditing data lineage | Intermediate Parquet |
| Building downstream applications | Processed CSV + Data Dictionary |
| Investigating quality issues | Quality Report JSON/HTML |


## Checkpoint System

The pipeline saves intermediate results as Parquet files after each major phase:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    subgraph Checkpoints
        CP1[01_raw] --> CP2[02_identity]
        CP2 --> CP3[03_classification]
        CP3 --> CP4[04_activity]
        CP4 --> CP5[05_temporal]
        CP5 --> CP6[06_financial]
        CP6 --> CP7[07_filing]
    end
```

| Checkpoint | Location | After Phase |
|-------------------------|---------------------|---------------------------|
| `01_raw` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_YYYY_MM_01_raw.parquet` | Extraction |
| `02_identity` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_YYYY_MM_02_identity.parquet` | Identity |
| `03_classification` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_YYYY_MM_03_classification.parquet` | Classification |
| `04_activity` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_YYYY_MM_04_activity.parquet` | Activity |
| `05_temporal` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_YYYY_MM_05_temporal.parquet` | Temporal |
| `06_financial` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_YYYY_MM_06_financial.parquet` | Financial |
| `07_filing` | `data/checkpoints/bmf_YYYY_MM_07_filing.parquet` | Filing |

**Benefits:** - Resume from failure without reprocessing - Debug specific phases - Compare intermediate states

To resume from a checkpoint:

``` r
bmf <- load_checkpoint("03_classification")
# Continue processing from Phase 4
```

## Configuration

Key configuration in `R/run_pipeline.R`:

``` r
# Pipeline settings (set at top of run_pipeline.R)
ENABLE_CHECKPOINTS <- TRUE       # Save intermediate results
CHECKPOINT_DIR <- "data/checkpoints"
STRICT_QUALITY_GATES <- TRUE     # Stop on validation failure
ENABLE_S3_UPLOAD <- TRUE 

# Override to process specific month (set before sourcing)
PROCESSING_YEAR <- NULL   # e.g., 2025
PROCESSING_MONTH <- NULL  # e.g., 1
```

S3 configuration in `R/config.R`:

``` r
# S3 bucket configuration
BMF_S3_BUCKET <- "nccsdata"
BMF_S3_PREFIX <- "raw/bmf/"
BMF_S3_INTERMEDIATE_PREFIX <- "intermediate/bmf/"
BMF_S3_PROCESSED_PREFIX <- "processed/bmf/"

# Download functions
download_bmf_from_s3(bucket, prefix, year, month)
list_available_bmf_files(bucket, prefix)
```
